commit.message:
Serve: the FP8 vision attention folds the rotary embedding into its Q/K preparation (and starts at 3072 patches) (#350)

The e4m3 vision attention rotated Q and K in place (ops::rope, BF16 out),
then read them again to round them to e4m3. One kernel now does both
(vision_fp8_rope_qk_kernel): the same coefficients (fixed_sincos), the same
explicitly rounded pair rotation, each value rounded to BF16 as the RoPE
kernel's store rounds it, then the same e4m3 rounding -- so its codes and
scales are bit for bit the two kernels', and the BF16 rotation is never
written. ops::vision_attention_fp8_rope serves where ops::rope takes its fixed
Vision2D / Vision2D64 kernel (16 heads, two axes, the whole head, theta
10000); elsewhere the tower rotates in place and takes the unfused e4m3 route.

Rotation + attention against rope + BF16 attention (GB10, D = 72, 16 heads,
quiet GPU): 0.99x / 1.08x / 1.12x / 1.22x / 1.24x at 2304 / 3136 / 4624 /
7056 / 12544 patches (unfused: 0.92x / 1.01x / 1.05x / 1.11x / 1.18x), so the
e4m3 attention now starts at 3072 patches (was 4096): 896x896 images take it.

test_vision_attention_fp8: the fused route's output is bit-identical to
ops::rope followed by vision_attention_fp8 (D = 72 and 64, one and four
segments), q and k are left unrotated, and 4 heads (ops::rope's generic
kernel) is declined; bench now times rotation and attention together.


Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019YJ7CbJ7TeysJ7tTejFvkM

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

@@ -61,6 +61,20 @@ void vision_attention(const Tensor& q, const Tensor& k, const Tensor& v,
                                         const Tensor& cu_seqlens, WorkspaceArena& workspace,
                                         DeviceSpan scratch, Tensor& out, cudaStream_t stream,
                                         float scale = 0.0F);
+/**
+ * vision_attention_fp8 with the tower's rotary embedding folded in: q and k are the unrotated
+ * projections, `positions` the [P, 2] I32 rotary positions ops::rope takes, and the rotation is
+ * applied on the way into e4m3 -- the same rotation, rounded to BF16 as ops::rope rounds it, so
+ * the result is bit for bit ops::rope followed by vision_attention_fp8. q and k are only read.
+ * Returns false, having enqueued nothing (q and k unrotated), wherever vision_attention_fp8 would
+ * or ops::rope would not take its fixed vision kernel (16 heads, two axes, rotary_dim == D, theta
+ * 10000), where bit-for-bit agreement is not on offer.
+ */
+[[nodiscard]] bool vision_attention_fp8_rope(const Tensor& q, const Tensor& k, const Tensor& v,
+                                             const Tensor& positions, std::int32_t rotary_dim,
+                                             float theta, const Tensor& cu_seqlens,
+                                             WorkspaceArena& workspace, DeviceSpan scratch,
+                                             Tensor& out, cudaStream_t stream, float scale = 0.0F);
 /// Scratch bytes vision_attention_fp8 needs for D x H x P; 0 for an unsupported D.
 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t vision_attention_fp8_scratch_bytes(std::int32_t head_dim,
                                                              std::int32_t heads,

@@ -261,7 +261,7 @@ std::string serve_usage_text(const char* argv0) {
            "       --vision-fp8 runs the vision tower's block projections in MXFP8 on a Blackwell\n"
            "         device (block-scaled FP8 at twice the BF16 rate; outputs change by FP8\n"
            "         rounding). The weights are quantized once at startup, beside the BF16 ones;\n"
-           "         on a 12.x device an image of 4096+ patches also takes FP8 attention\n"
